name: darkmux-viewer-parity
description: The React port's parity harness. goldens/*.txt is a FROZEN spec captured from the legacy viewer (retired in #1806; recover its source with `git show v2.9.0:crates/darkmux-serve/assets/viewer.html`) against a real daemon. The next-parity* suites grade the React port against those goldens. record.mjs + tripwire.mjs remain for capturing/scanning corpus/ fixtures; rebaselining a golden is now a direct hand-edit in a reviewed diff, not a regeneration script. Self-contained; does not touch tests/e2e.
